_note: BUILDING-FACE-POSE-1. mc2_05 non-degradation set. mc2_05 is the only tier map that runs a real day/night cycle (DayToNightTime = 864000 in the mission .fit, versus -1 on mc2_01/03/10/24) and its night lighting is USER-APPROVED, so any prop-lighting change has to be shown NOT to damage it -- but no mc2_05 bookmark set existed in this directory at all, which left that claim unverifiable. This file closes that hole. Sites are building-class object clusters read out of the mission .pak packet-1 object list and classified by ObjectTypeClass (method note in mc2_10_building_faces.json): 'liao_compound' = the 82-object walled compound at (-4009,-2751) (Liao medium walls and gates, SRM turrets, large fuel tanks, HeavyIndustrial); 'east_compound' = the 82-object walled compound at (3133,-1788); 'refinery' = the 34-object plant at (-1006,4587). KNOWN GAP, recorded rather than hidden: a pose was also authored at the 34-object LiaoSpotlight cluster (-236,448), because those fixtures ARE the approved night look, and it was REMOVED on measurement -- two identical gate-OFF runs of it differ on 84-91 percent of pixels, since the animated spotlight/cone glow does not resolve to the same frame twice. No A/B can be graded there until that pose is made stable, so the spotlight fixtures themselves remain unverified by this set; the compounds around them are covered. The poses kept here were each confirmed byte-identical across two gate-OFF runs. Sun azimuth = LightDirYaw(15)+45 = 60 deg. The control frames terrain carrying no building-class object.
